{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA test orders and refunded orders
valid_orders = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = valid_orders.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue_clean', ascending=False)

# Print the results
total_revenue_by_channel"}
